dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Observed multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the mid-lateral flank. Perimeter geometry is characterized by a high-contrast transition from the dark grey base to a thin, silver-white band, with a lower-intensity grey interior core. One prominent 'O' annulus is located in the lower-central region with a clearly defined closed perimeter.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of amorphous, solid high-intensity white/silver pixel clusters without internal gradients, primarily concentrated along the upper dorsal ridge and the posterior lateral region. These clusters appear more aggregated and less geometric than the annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent 'O' shaped annuli in the central flank form a near-equilateral triangle. A larger scalene triangle is formed by connecting the centroids of the two largest dorsal blobs to the most distinct lower-central annulus.
